info.description:
API documentation for Roaspy.

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `200 OK` | Response to a successful GET, PUT, PATCH or DELETE |
| `201 Created` | Response to a successful POST |
| `400 Bad Request` | Malformed request; form validation errors |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Wrong API-Key or not provided |
| `429 Too Many Requests` | Number of API requests per minute exceeded |

## Rate Limiting

| Limit Type | Requests | Window |
|------------|----------|--------|
| Per Minute | 1000 | 60 seconds |

| Header | Description | Example |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Rate limit capacity | `1000` |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining in the window | `782` |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Seconds until the rate limit resets | `48` |
